notes:
The current supported residence provides staff supervision and secure medication storage.

The patient reports stable relationships with family and expects no relationship changes before the next report.

The relationship reporting condition is monitored during weekly supervision visits.

When asked directly about relationships, the patient said the partner knows about the reporting condition; staff also confirm attendance at planned visits.

The patient attends an art class three times a week and enjoys painting.

The diagnosis remains unchanged from the previous clinical report.

The prescribed medication is administered by residence staff and each administered dose is recorded.

The patient has taken every prescribed dose during this reporting period.

No new physical illness has affected treatment attendance during this reporting period.

The clinical supervisor saw the patient at the community clinic on 20 September 2026.

The patient says regular attendance at the art class is the main progress since discharge.

The patient has read the report and had an opportunity to add comments about the report.
